tytul: Chorizo curado: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Spanish chorizo curado, a raw dry sausage with smoked paprika (pimentón). [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: According to UGA, a sausage is shelf stable only when its water activity is below 0.85 and its pH is under 5.3. [T:MIE-023]
Without an effective starter culture, fermentation temperatures of 80–100 °F can let dangerous bacteria grow in the meat. [T:MIE-025]

akapity: According to UGA, E. coli O157:H7 in dry fermented sausages is controlled by strict control of fermentation and acidity, and by heating to 145 °F or above after fermentation. [T:MIE-024]
In dry sausages, control of Salmonella takes a combination of a starter culture, the fermentation temperature, and control of pH, curing salt and salt. [T:MIE-027]
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for chorizo curado from a checked source. [T:-]
